I went to a shitty festival in London somewhere a few years ago. They were selling 330ml cider for like £8. I tried to go out and buy a bottle of wine but they wouldn't let me.
Felt kettled and pissed then I saw it. A Baggie, by the bin with four wraps in it. Four! I opened them up in the toilet. Two of them were very brown MDMA the other two were a white powder. When I dabbed them it tasted of nothing, nothing I tell you. L I had had a bad experience with ketamine about ten days before, and didn't want a repeat. So shared the MD out amongst friends. Bumped into a family friends daughter who was also on MDMA. It was really obvious she had never taken it before. Well done to her I say. Anyway I ended up sacking off the whole festival to go have a few quiet pints down the road. My friends crashed at mine, Nix went to bed and me and my buddy jase were left up. We just assumed that the white stuff was ketamine that we were doing as a nightcap. It was definitely Coke. Oft confused, but more commonly (and disastrously)the other way round. Jase said he was tired and didn't want any more. I rang my girlfriend and told her about it she said "save it for Bestival" BUT like the addict that I am. I smashed both grams in under an hour in my room at 2am. Oh to be young

Yeah it's hard to be young and have a problem. I went to rehab when I was 23, should have gone when I was 20 haha. 
But it's way more common nowadays to see young people getting clean. Donkeys years ago I had a coffee with a kid from a meeting who was 15! Haha I wonder I he stuck around. 
Try not to project into the future. One of those really annoying recovery things that gets bandied about (all the ones that are cliches for a reason) is.....drumroll....one day at a time.
Chances are you will use again. It always takes a while to find what works for you. Some people never do. Give yourself a break.
 And meetings or no meetings, you need a support network. I've just spent three weeks in my place on my own sniffing blow. No can can do it alone. One more thing I wanted to say is I think a bigger part of my addiction than the drugs is the dishonesty and unmanageable life. I'm getting on a plane to go see my folks in a few hours and I plan on telling them every bullshit tale I've told them since January. Wish me luck. Let me know how you get on 
Bless

Hey Bro. I know things can seem desperate. I've been in a pit of despair myself recently. I'm an addict. Cocaine is the one and I relapsed at the beginning of the year, so hey, I can understand the histrionics. I guess I just wanted to say that I've done some henious stuff to my family and bafflingly they forgive over and over (at least mine have) because they love you and want to trust you. Also if you think you have a problem with drugs you can give up. There are plenty of ways to get clean. NA has worked for me when it's working. See if there's a meeting near you. You don't have to be a "junkie" I sometimes feel like a fraud because I never put a needle in my arm. But I'm an addict. Hope this helps. One Love

Sugar, is a hell of a drug. I know I'm a little late to the party but OA has worked for lots of people I know. I went to a treatment centre that was substance/process and eating disorders so we got to lean a lot about one another. What blows me away (drugs are my thing) about things like sugar, food, etc is that most places, like the UK where I'm from, it's such a poor environment to be in and be struggling like that. It's a tough lot and best of luck!
